description: Direct NaiveDate.Filter and NaiveDate.range composable filter pipeline fixtures validating filter order sensitivity, edge-rank bySetPos, calendar boundaries, and article/benchmark rules.

cases.name: lunch_closure_after_bysetpos_drops_march
cases.notes: Demonstrates order sensitivity: excluding after bySetPos drops March instead of falling back

cases.name: bydoy_sunday_start_week_jan1
cases.notes: byDayOfYear on a Sunday-start week containing Jan 1 must anchor to the week tuple, not reanchor to Monday

cases.name: weekly_month_limit_before_nested_bysetpos
cases.notes: MonthLimit composed before nested bySetPos restricts candidates to February before positional selection

cases.name: nested_compose_month_restricts_bysetpos
cases.notes: MonthLimit propagates through nested compose() to restrict bySetPos before ranking straddling week days

cases.name: deeply_nested_compose_month_restricts_bysetpos
cases.notes: MonthLimit propagates through multi-level nested compose() to restrict inner bySetPos

cases.name: wrapped_month_limit_compose_preserves_straddling_week
cases.notes: Wrapping byMonthOfYear inside compose() still exposes MonthLimit straddling/keeps to an outer compose()

cases.name: doubly_wrapped_month_limit_and_bysetpos_compose
cases.notes: Nested compose() on both MonthLimit and bySetPos sides preserves straddling weeks and restricts positional selection

cases.name: nested_compose_bysetpos_and_month_limit_associativity
cases.notes: Nested compose([first, janFeb]) between feb and allDays stays equivalent to flat compose([feb, first, janFeb, allDays])
